common.tagline: Your step-by-step ally, all the way to university
common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a few seconds.

landing.eyebrow: For students applying to universities and scholarships
landing.title: From the first “where do I go?” to the day you land.
landing.lead: Kumo keeps deadlines, exams, scholarships and documents in one place, and each day tells you the one thing that matters. Your family sees your progress; you decide what else.
landing.p1d: Every morning, one card: what to do today, how long it takes and why it matters.
landing.p2d: Every deadline shows where it came from and whether it is confirmed or estimated.
landing.p3d: A clear view for your parents, without seeing what is private.

login.title: Sign in to Kumo
login.lead: We email you a link. No passwords.
login.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
login.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email, like name@gmail.com.
login.devOutbox: Development mode: see the sent email

onboarding.nameLead: This is how Kumo greets you. You can change it anytime.
onboarding.tzLead: We use your time zone so every foreign deadline shows in your time.
onboarding.spaceLead: Your whole process lives here. Only you decide who else gets in.

home.lead: Your space is ready. Here are your first steps.
home.importBody: Import a pack with universities, scholarships and deadlines. You see the changes before saving.
home.inviteBody: Your parents will see your progress and can approve expenses. What is private stays yours.
home.noData: No data yet. Start by importing a pack.

import.title: Import data
import.lead: Choose the .json files from your data folder. You will first see what gets created or updated; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.invalid: We don’t recognise this format. Use the data/ folder or a Kumo pack (.json).

members.title: People with access
members.lead: You decide who sees your process and what they can do.
members.messagePlaceholder: Dad, this way you can see how I’m doing.
members.neverList: Your journal, your wellbeing check-ins or anything you mark private.

roleHelp.guardian: Sees your progress, deadlines and expenses; approves fees. Cannot edit.
roleHelp.mentor: Comments on your list and essays. Does not see your finances.

invite.title: {inviter} invites you to Kumo
invite.lead: You are invited as {role} to the space “{space}”.
invite.wrongEmail: This invitation is for {email}. Sign in with that email.
invite.expired: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
invite.emailSubject: {inviter} invites you to follow their journey on Kumo
invite.emailBody: {inviter} invites you as {role}. You will see their progress, upcoming deadlines and anything they need from you.
